_doc: The LEVEL rail's hand-set facts (docs/Sources/proposal_level_rail_last_bar_identity_2026-10-15.md). The last-bar identity explains every other level change from the provider's own split and dividend record; only these need declaring. scale_defect: the write may make a level change the declared_ratio explains (the declared write IS the restoration). reused_ticker: class (i) — the cached file is another entity; never written.
